layout.touch_board: DFRobot DFR0030 V2 on two posts with two printed clips

checks.basis: OP1 board, socket, plug and lead envelopes are photo-derived (Endgame Gear EGG-SP-U1); the 7.35 mm free and 6.7-7.1 mm operating heights are the Omron reference switch. DFR0030 length 35 mm (distributor sheet; maker says 30), hole pitch/position and 1.6 mm thickness are photo-derived or assumed. Its Gravity pin tails are checked at 1.5 and 2.0 mm, at +/-0.5 x +/-0.6 mm positions from the maker photo; tail length is not measured. Stop and travel values are nominal CAD, not measured force, feel or fatigue. R42 lowers only the DFR0030 seat within the same bracket; the OP1 envelopes, plug clearance and switch heights are R41's. R44 places the four outer key platforms 1.42 mm above R42 (0.30 mm below R43) and joins rounded middle finger rests to the existing guards; complete CAD checks rerun against translated bought-key envelopes and loading routes. Finger comfort is a CAD probe only.

lowering.limiting_geometry: Touch board: the bracket floor top (19.2), set by the fixed switch plunger. OP1 stack: the harness plug beside the rod (0.31 mm, closing about 0.75 mm per mm).

composition.construction: procedural: R44 at R47 + R45 standing45/standing_web45 + R46 brace stations + R47 chin/landing

layout.connector: Molex 2 mm, pin 1 negative; remains outside the cradle
